SELECT id,k,COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY k) AS members,
      COUNT(k) OVER (PARTITION BY k) AS nonnull,
      SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(id) OVER (PARTITION BY k)) AS member_ids FROM float_scalar_mixed

SELECT id,k,COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY k,id%2) AS members,
      SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(id) OVER (PARTITION BY k,id%2)) AS member_ids FROM float_scalar_mixed

SELECT id,k,ROW_NUMBER() OVER w AS position,
      LAG(k,1) OVER w AS previous_value,
      COLLECT_LIST(id) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS member_ids
      FROM float_scalar_mixed WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY id)

SELECT id,k,
              RANK() OVER (ORDER BY k ) AS rank,DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY k ) AS dense_rank,
              COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY k  RANGE BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND CURRENT ROW) AS peers,
              SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(id) OVER (ORDER BY k  RANGE BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND CURRENT ROW)) AS peer_ids,
              ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY k ,id) AS position,LAG(k,1) OVER (ORDER BY k ,id) AS previous_value,
              COLLECT_LIST(id) OVER (ORDER BY k ,id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS nearby_ids
              FROM float_scalar_mixed

SELECT id,k,
              RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY id%2 ORDER BY k ) AS rank,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY id%2 ORDER BY k ) AS dense_rank,
